notes.title: Snaky Survivor Update: A Whole New Way to Play!
notes.content:
I've been working on a big update with lots of changes and new content! [i]soul/health[/i] now plays a more interactive role, making strategy and exploration more important than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/ccc203305d2a78fb54688cc06e5a55fdd884c280.gif[/img]

[h3]Levels are now organized in a map (with a minimap)[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can choose which rooms to visit, but unlocking them costs a soul.
[*] New items added: keys, collectibles, and more!
[*] Think Binding of Isaac or Zelda, but minimalist.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/bc3fa75ac9a538ddd46b341cd89c34403aa67174.gif[/img]

[h3]More Level Types[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Survival rooms[/b] – Stay alive until time runs out.
[*] [b]Enemy rooms[/b] – Trick enemies into taking themselves out.
[*] [b]Exploration rooms[/b] – Navigate mazes to find the exit.
[*] [b]Boss rooms[/b] – Defeat the boss to clear the room.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/1fe4b14ddee74e28bae5c7bfafce765cdfef889c.gif[/img]

[h3]New Player Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dodging is more important[/b] – Use hazards to your advantage.
[*] [b]Drop your soul mid-game[/b] – Use it as bait to outsmart enemies.
[*] [b]More movement tricks[/b] – Dash, indirect attacks, bouncing, etc. (still experimenting!)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/58cb2d755f618296f5f76b83553529c434eee868.gif[/img]

[h3]Future Plans & Milestones[/h3]
[list]
[*] Working on these features until the end of March/April.
[*] One full playable map coming in the update.
[*] More content will be added based on feedback.
[*] The original game will remain playable.
[/list]

The original version (no new content yet) is [b]on sale now![/b] Grab it or try the demo—your feedback will help shape the game’s future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566240/Snaky_Survivor/

Fiery Squirrel

notes.title: Update 0.4.4
notes.content:
This is a regular update with few new features and changes.

[h2]Enemies Collision[/h2]
Enemies collide with each other now. Depending on the [i]strength[/i] of the enemy, when they collide with each other, some of them will destroy others. If enemies are the same kind, the general rule is that both will be destroyed. Saws, Lasers and Wall/Blocks cannot be destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/4f25e18267491c684a491eccf3ff87fae3542ac3.gif[/img]

[h2]Rate Levels[/h2]
I want to start improving the level design, whenever you feel like it, you can rate levels now. Depending on the results, I will try to change levels to make them more interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/32d27bf0445a4ec7581f95a7bd75a19e9ad0cbac.png[/img]

[h2]Game Difficulty[/h2]
Since a couple of previous updates, the core mechanics changed and every time you start a level now, health is restored 100%. This change makes the game easier, compared to the original design so I decided to increase the difficulty. Levels will keep evolving in the upcoming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/79c3665c9da4f67b89a10f61124738d3f28346a5.gif[/img]

As always, if you've got any comments, let me know.

Have fun!

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️

notes.title: Autumn Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UwM1aGpIgTc;full][/previewyoutube]

I've been testing this new update for a couple of weeks and I'm very excited to finally share it with you all. This new changes are themed around Autumn; it was initially planned to be a Halloween themed updated but decided to spend more time polishing the content and adding more new stuff.

[h2]Bomb[/h2]
There is a new bomb type of enemy, it will explode after few seconds and whatever that is in the area (Player or Soul) will get hurt. In addition, if you or maybe the lasers hits it, it will explode too and cause the same effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/d407fe260450b602d74788609ecd72e8d87f094a.gif[/img]

[h2]Ghost/Bullet[/h2]
This new enemy appears at the edge of the screen and aims at the player when appearing. It will follow a path straight to the player but without re-aiming so it's not as deadly but can go through walls, which tries to [i]force[/i] the player to change position wherever it is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/ccc203305d2a78fb54688cc06e5a55fdd884c280.gif[/img]

[h2]Levels[/h2]
We have 15 new levels now, all of them featuring the new enemies in combination with the original ones. Depending on how the update is received, new levels might be added with these new enemies to increase the content and challenge as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/c3dde80eead3594ea167e9d3357a03f12aad7eea.gif[/img]

[h2]New Ideas[/h2]
[list]
[*] Level editor
[*] Color theme editor
[*] Zen mode: no time, more relaxed and less pressure
[*] More dodging skills
[*] Randomly generated levels
[*] Leaderboard & Achievements
[*] More levels
[/list]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
From the previous list of ideas I'll probably pick few and keep adding stuff to improve the experience. If there is anything from the list that you would like to play/experience first, just let me know and I'll make it happen sooner. Also, if you have any other suggestions, feel free to share them, the game will keep evolving and would be great to have your input for that!

Hope you enjoy the update,

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️

notes.title: Update 0.3.7
notes.content:
Hello!

I've decided to make few important changes about the core mechanics of the game.

[h3]Lives as a currency[/h3]
Lives don't work as a currency anymore. Levels now begin with a specific amount of health (most of the time 100%) and you will just have to survive by the end of the level when the time is up. Once you clear a level, you can go to the next one or replay it to get better results.

[h3]Continues[/h3]
Since lives don't work as a currency anymore, continues (stars) don't make sense so I removed them too. Levels can be played as many times as you want.

[h3]Enemies damage[/h3]
With the previous changes, the game is now easier so in order to balance the difficulty, enemies are more dangerous now. Damage was increased for all the existing enemies.

[h3]Level selector[/h3]
There is a new menu to select which level you want to play, just a regular level picker, which now allows you to replay levels if you want get a better score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/739d869a9bca91d2d79bea5119b7d77206fcd8d5.png[/img]

[h3]Credits[/h3]
There is now a screen for credits. Go to Settings -> Credits. Thanks again to people that provided feedback!

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Soul appears on top of enemies
[*] Bounding box for soul was too small
[*] Lives were not properly updated on the HUD
[/list]

[h2]Autumn Update (Coming soon)[/h2]
There is new content coming to the game, it's already prepared but I'll take some time to polish it as much as possible before release. You can get a sneak peek of the new levels below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/b9b6437abab8caaa372a89cf108d12c5cbd4c46a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/1b383cc1a34b93783043ee7636fa85eea1a46f38.gif[/img]

[h3]Other features I'm working on for a future update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balance difficulty to match the new core changes
[*] Improve the level selector
[*] Improve current level design
[*] Level editor
[*] Colors editor
[*] New game modes: Randomly generated
[*] Leaderboard and Achievements
[/list]

I'm also working on a demo that will be released after the Autumn Update, if you're still unsure about the game, I hope you can give it a try and decide whether you want to keep playing.

Happy gaming!

- Fiery Squirrel
🔥🐿️

notes.title: Snaky Survivor slithers into Early Access in ONE WEEK!
notes.content:
Snaky Survivor will release into Early Access next week, on [b]September 14th, 2023[/b]!

[previewyoutube=zUWWhs7Qtlc;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/9ae5c9cb64244c8c1c3ba6f62456acc39d24735b.png[/img]
As you can see from the video, the basic mechanics are really simple: collect as much soul as you can and don't get hit by enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/da3fed7a9ac0cd9c66eb88d0ea4826c53f59fdba.gif[/img]

The amount of soul you collect will keep you alive but it will also serve other purposes:

[h3]Move forward[/h3]
Each level has a price, which is paid in pieces of soul that you collect. Every time a level ends, you will decide whether you want to play one more time to collect more soul or you want to go to the next level. Prices start very low and keep increasing throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/81a86e2f8b4bdc77a3dea5c7e2149aa91422b2bc.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus levels & Stars[/h3]
In case you fail a level, you will have the opportunity to play again, to do so you need stars. Stars are items that can be purchased using your soul (the same soul you collect) while playing bonus levels. 

Once you reach a bonus level, you'll have the chance to get stars, it will be up to you to decide whether you want them or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/df768ee73ccf0b81cc3982f65eef05a5d4e4f365.png[/img]
If you dodge an enemy from a very close distance, your dodge score will increase. If you perform three dodge actions in a row, more soul will be generated and so your score will continue increasing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576949/aa897036614f4b40a1b6cc9ffdda629cf9a394de.gif[/img]

Dodging enemies is not required to clear levels or complete the game but they add an element of challenge and reward to the game.

Stay tuned for more content in the upcoming days!

- Fiery Squirrel
